doc: Logo library. Each file is the unaltered brand icon served by the owner's official site (bytes as fetched; extension matches the actual format). Logos are trademarks of their owners and identify their products. No endorsement implied. images/banks and images/cards hold PerTheTerms placeholder art, not issuer logos, so they are not listed here.
